children: Centrifuge's fixed-income market goes live on Arc at mainnet launch, bringing tokenized Treasuries (JTRSY), AAA CLOs (JAAA) and high-yield bonds (HYB) onchain from day one alongside asset managers JHI Advisors and New York Life Investment Management.

Launching the market at genesis gives Arc a flagship real-world asset use case from its first block rather than through a later integration. Tokenized Treasuries, AAA CLOs and high-yield bonds sit onchain from day one, so the network starts with income-producing collateral instead of an empty state.

For HYB, the launch extends market access to a new chain, and for ARC holders it provides a concrete utility driver tied to actual asset flows. Participation in tokenized funds may still depend on investor eligibility rules set by the issuers.
